briefing.headline: AI and chip stocks fell sharply last week, and the Nasdaq had its worst week since 2020, with a partial rebound starting Monday.

points.text: The Nasdaq fell 10% last week, its worst week since the early days of Covid in 2020. Anthropic and Nvidia shares rose in early trading Monday.
points.label: reported

points.text: The S&P 500 has entered a correction. Bloomberg reports AI stocks may rebound from here.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia shares rose Monday after the Trump administration pushed for Jensen Huang to return as chief executive.
points.label: reported

points.text: The U.S. is investigating Megaspeed and Alice Huang. A former associate of hers was reportedly 'deeply involved' in the firm's activities.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic's shares fell 8.5%, which has raised doubts about China's AI IPO pipeline. Bloomberg says the next China AI deals are clouded.
